notes: TERM SYSTEM: Starting in 1447 AH (2025-26), the Ministry went back from three terms to two. The old term books were merged into two parts, and unit numbers now run on across both terms. The current school year is 1448 (2026-27). Term-1 lists come from the 1448 curriculum distribution plans (توزيع المنهج) on madty.net. Term-2 lists come from the 1447 term-2 books, because 1448 term-2 material was not found. Between 1447 and 1448, several grades moved one unit from term 2 to term 1: G4 الاقتصاد, G5 جغرافية وطني, G6 المملكة العربية السعودية, G7 العصر النبوي, G8 أغلفة كوكب الأرض, and G9 التنمية الوطنية + الأنظمة في المملكة. Each unit is listed once, in the term it has in 1448. Unit titles keep the book's numbering, so gaps in the numbers mean a unit was excluded. Grades 1-3 have no social-studies book. SECONDARY (نظام المسارات): there is no separate «التربية الوطنية» book now. G10 (common first year) has «الدراسات الاجتماعية», taught in one term (term 2). G11 has «التاريخ», in term 1 of the general track and term 2 of the Sharia track. G12 has «الجغرافيا», in term 2 of the general track and term 1 of the Sharia track. Related secondary subjects NOT included: المواطنة الرقمية، الدراسات النفسية والاجتماعية، مبادئ القانون/تطبيقات في القانون (Sharia track), المعرفة المالية (G10), المهارات الحياتية. EXCLUDED as religious: G4-T2 units «الأنبياء» and «السيرة النبوية», plus the lesson «قبلة المسلمين». G5-T1 unit 1 «الخلفاء الراشدون» (5 lessons). G7-T1 unit 4 «العصر النبوي», except the lesson «شبه الجزيرة العربية قبل ظهور الإسلام» (6 lessons dropped). G7-T2 unit 5 «عصر الخلفاء الراشدين» (3-4 lessons). KEPT but possibly sensitive for drawing: G11 «عمارة الحرمين الشريفين» (architecture and state history of the Two Holy Mosques). Lessons on real Saudi kings and imams were also kept, along with «الحِجر (مدائن صالح)». The app may want to decide whether these get cartoons. LESSON TITLES come from distribution plans and book indexes, with prefixes such as «توزيع درس» or «حل درس» removed and obvious typos fixed. The sources number units inconsistently; madty.net was treated as primary and beadaya/mnhaji/wajibati as cross-checks. CONCEPTS: every entry has concepts_inferred=true. The concepts were inferred from the confirmed lesson titles and the usual terms of the Saudi social-studies books. They were NOT checked against the PDFs, because the ien.edu.sa book pages could not be read. Each lesson has 4-7 concepts. Specific named items (people, battles, places, programmes) are the most likely examples and should be spot-checked. TOTALS: 15 grade-term entries, 275 lessons, 1,468 concept mentions, and about 1,105 unique concept strings. Several concepts repeat across grades, e.g. خطوط الطول ودوائر العرض, الخريطة, الدولة السعودية الأولى, رؤية المملكة 2030.
